title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS, log phase metered at 2^93.2: 2^93.700724227

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+2^93.700724226 < 2^93.700724227 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). There is no run gate. Both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^93.2 units that aborts as failure, so the ledger charges the logarithm phase at 2^93.2 in every run; the descent recurrence (expected 2^90.883942) enters only success, through Markov P(cap) <= 0.200816, giving modeled success 0.797214. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes the 171 earlier entered-node PGF strata, which the default run also replays. part=h5 recomputes ADAPTIVE.md's conditional next-relation tables (627 attempts after an earlier failed relation, failure and child-work observed/envelope with root-cluster bootstrap) from h5data.b85; the default run checks the totals. These are toy-scale measurements; transfer to production sizes is H5. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
